findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization rendered with hardcoded empty data on feature-flag branch
findings.body: When the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature flag is enabled, the new branch in `tableResultComponent` renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} />` with hardcoded empty values instead of forwarding the actual `result.data`, `result.meta`, `eventView`, `fields`, `location`, `fieldAliases`, `fieldHeaderMap`, etc. that are still computed above the conditional. Anyone with this flag on will see completely empty table widgets in their dashboards. The non-flagged branch correctly renders `<StyledSimpleTableChart ... data={result.data} metadata={result.meta} ... />`, so the new code path appears to be an unfinished placeholder that needs to be wired up to the same `result` data.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before feature-flag check
findings.body: The new `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` call is placed before the `features.has("organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble", ...)` gate. Any caller without the feature flag still gets a 404 response, but the analytics event is emitted anyway, so the preprod assemble analytics will be inflated by traffic from orgs/projects that have no access to the feature. The analytics call should be moved after the feature check (and ideally inside the try/else branch that actually enqueues work) so it only counts requests that are processed.
